residuals.detail: The freefunc receives no type tag. The element type is a convention of each registration site (the stack's declared element type `STACK_OF(X509)` / `STACK_OF(X509_CRL)`), not a property the type system enforces. A new registration of either thunk on a stack of a different element type would violate the contract; no such registration exists in src/.

The externally controllable trigger for the CRL failure arm (a type-0 choice with a NULL datum) faults inside `X509_CRL_up_ref(NULL)` before `x509_crl_free_void` is installed, because X509_CRL_up_ref dereferences its argument (src/x509/x_crl.rs:1308-1315). That is authority-identical behaviour for C-invalid opaque-layout misuse (constructing a type-0 revision choice with a NULL datum through `CMS_add0_RevocationInfoChoice`), not a B70 defect: a decoded type-0 revision choice always carries a live CRL. The only remaining trigger is an `OPENSSL_sk_push` allocation failure. This is a caller-side precondition of the failure arm, not a precondition of the freefunc, so it does not change CMS-FREE-002's contract; the arm is recorded NOT_RUN rather than claimed. x509_crl_free_void was never executed (tracer hit=0).

In ossl_cms_get1_crls_ex, when `X509_CRL_up_ref` succeeds but `OPENSSL_sk_push` fails, the failure arm drains only the stack: the up-ref'd CRL that failed to push is outside the stack and is not released, leaving one extra reference. This is authority-identical (cms_lib.c has the same short-circuit and the same drain-only cleanup), reachable only on allocation failure, and is not repaired here because src/ is out of scope for this batch.

The closure attaches both boundaries' disposition texts to each of the two obligations (boundary_dispositions is the set over the file/operation); this is a reporting artifact only. The per-obligation discharge_boundary_id (CMS-FREE-001 / CMS-FREE-002) and status_reason are correct.

not_run.blocker: NOT_RUN: the private thunk was never executed (tracer hit=0). The thunk body/callee are verified statically (disassembly at 0x1945b0); the callee is exercised through the exported pop_free path, NULL-element and direct-NULL cases, but that is not thunk coverage.
